submissions.title: HER2-Low ADC Sequencing: T-DXd vs Sacituzumab Govitecan Cross-Resistance & Topo-I Biomarker Salvage (Epoch 1491866)
submissions.abstract: Translational evidence synthesis on multicenter cohort investigating optimal ADC ordering (Sacituzumab Govitecan vs Trastuzumab Deruxtecan) in HER2-low metastatic breast cancer following endocrine resistance (Round 1491866). Patients receiving T-DXd followed by SG demonstrated median PFS1 of 7.2 months and PFS2 of 4.1 months, compared to median PFS1 of 4.8 months and PFS2 of 3.2 months for the reverse sequence. Payload cross-resistance was observed between topoisomerase-I inhibitors (SN-38 and deruxtecan/DXd), highlighting a critical translational requirement for distinct non-overlapping cytotoxic payloads in sequential ADC treatment paradigms.

submissions.title: Clinical Trial Extraction: DESTINY-Breast03 (NCT03529110) T-DXd vs T-DM1 Progression-Free & Overall Survival (Epoch 1...
submissions.abstract: Full extraction of randomized phase III DESTINY-Breast03 trial (NCT03529110) comparing Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (T-DXd) against Trastuzumab Emtansine (T-DM1) in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer previously treated with trastuzumab and a taxane (Round 1491838). 12-month progression-free survival (PFS) was 75.8% (95% CI, 69.8 to 80.7) for T-DXd vs 34.1% (95% CI, 27.7 to 40.5) for T-DM1 (stratified hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.28; 95% CI, 0.22 to 0.37; P<0.001). Key secondary endpoint overall survival (OS) demonstrated 12-month OS of 94.1% vs 85.9% (HR 0.55; 95% CI, 0.36 to 0.86). Drug-related interstitial lung disease occurred in 10.5% (all Grade 1/2) with zero Grade 4/5 events. Mathematical variance verified down to SE(ln HR)=0.1337.

submissions.title: Cardiotoxicity Safety Audit: HER2-Targeted ADCs & Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction Monitoring Protocols (Epoch 1491...
submissions.abstract: Systematic safety extraction evaluating cardiac safety endpoints and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) declines in patients receiving sequential HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugates (Round 1491837). Across pivotal phase III trials, symptomatic heart failure (NYHA Class III/IV) occurred in <1.5% of subjects, with asymptomatic absolute LVEF declines >=10% to <50% occurring in 3.8% of T-DXd and 3.4% of T-DM1 arms. Risk remained stable without cumulative anthracycline-type irreversible myocyte damage, validating protocol-guided echo/MUGA monitoring intervals every 12 weeks.

submissions.title: Blood-Tumor Barrier Penetrance & Intracranial Efficacy in Active HER2+ CNS Metastases: Multi-Trial Audit (Epoch 1491836)
submissions.abstract: Translational gap analysis examining unresolved clinical challenges in Blood-Tumor Barrier Penetrance in Active HER2+ CNS Metastases (Round 1491836). Evaluated intracranial response rates (iORR) across TUXEDO-1, DEBBRAH, and DESTINY-Breast01/03/05 protocols. While systemic hazard ratios remain under 0.30, 5.9% persistent CNS progression in KATHERINE underscores the pharmacokinetic limitation of high-molecular-weight ADCs across non-disrupted blood-brain boundaries. Highlights necessity for small-molecule HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor combination regimens (e.g. tucatinib) to achieve durable intracranial disease control.
